overcoming_the_monster.name: Overcoming the Monster
overcoming_the_monster.shape: A threat grows until the heroes confront and destroy it

stages.name: Call
stages.purpose: The threat shows itself and the party is drawn in.

stages.name: Early success
stages.purpose: The party wins small victories and thinks it has the measure of the threat.

stages.name: Frustration
stages.purpose: The threat proves stronger and smarter; allies are lost or plans fail.

stages.name: Nightmare
stages.purpose: The threat strikes back at its worst and the party is at its lowest.

stages.name: Final confrontation
stages.purpose: The party confronts the source of the threat and ends it.

rags_to_riches.name: Rags to Riches
rags_to_riches.shape: The humble rise, lose everything, and earn it back for real

stages.name: Humble start
stages.purpose: Show the party's small lives and the thing they lack.

stages.name: Early rise
stages.purpose: A first stroke of luck or skill lifts them toward a new station.

stages.name: Central crisis
stages.purpose: They lose what they gained and see what it cost them.

stages.name: Independence
stages.purpose: They rebuild by their own hands and grow past their old needs.

stages.name: Final union
stages.purpose: They claim a lasting place, having become worthy of it.

the_quest.name: The Quest
the_quest.shape: A long journey toward a goal through trials and temptations

stages.name: Call
stages.purpose: A goal worth a journey is set and the party commits to it.

stages.name: Journey
stages.purpose: The road brings allies, wonders, rivals and small trials.

stages.name: Arrival and frustration
stages.purpose: The goal seems within reach, then slips away behind a new obstacle.

stages.name: Final ordeals
stages.purpose: The hardest trials, with temptations to turn back or cheat.

stages.name: Goal
stages.purpose: The party reaches the goal and learns what it is really worth.

voyage_and_return.name: Voyage and Return
voyage_and_return.shape: Into a strange world, then a hard escape home, changed

stages.name: Fall into the strange
stages.purpose: The party crosses into an unfamiliar world with its own rules.

stages.name: Fascination
stages.purpose: The strange world is wondrous and welcoming, and hides its cost.

stages.name: Frustration
stages.purpose: The rules turn against the party and the way home is not clear.

stages.name: Nightmare
stages.purpose: The strange world closes in and the party is hunted.

stages.name: Escape and return
stages.purpose: A narrow escape home, and a home that looks different now.

comedy.name: Comedy
comedy.shape: Confusion and misunderstandings pile up, then untangle

stages.name: Order disturbed
stages.purpose: A small upset breaks the settled order of the place.

stages.name: Confusion
stages.purpose: Mistakes, disguises and crossed purposes multiply.

stages.name: Peak of muddle
stages.purpose: Everything goes wrong at once and everyone suspects the wrong person.

stages.name: Revelation
stages.purpose: The truth comes out, and it is not what anyone assumed.

stages.name: Reconciliation
stages.purpose: Order returns, better than before, with the foolish forgiven.

tragedy.name: Tragedy
tragedy.shape: Ambition or a flaw leads to ruin (softened to loss at "family")

stages.name: Anticipation
stages.purpose: The party is drawn toward a desire, a duty or a bargain.

stages.name: Dream
stages.purpose: Things go well; the desire seems within reach and costs are ignored.

stages.name: Frustration
stages.purpose: Small cracks widen and choices narrow.

stages.name: Nightmare
stages.purpose: The party's own choices turn on it and allies are lost.

stages.name: Downfall
stages.purpose: The cost comes due. Loss and consequence, never cruelty for its own sake.

rebirth.name: Rebirth
rebirth.shape: A dark spell or flaw holds sway until redemption breaks it

stages.name: Shadow falls
stages.purpose: A dark influence settles over a person, a place or the party.

stages.name: Apparent calm
stages.purpose: Life seems to go on while the shadow quietly deepens.

stages.name: Tightening grip
stages.purpose: The shadow tightens and escape looks unlikely.

stages.name: Darkest hour
stages.purpose: All seems lost and the party must face the heart of it.

stages.name: Awakening
stages.purpose: An act of courage, love or honesty breaks the hold.
